page.layout: One printed page: two columns of index entries under the running head, with the Z entries in the right column, and FINIS centred below both columns. The strip of printed text at the far left is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
page.notes: The large Z at the start of "Zacheus" is an initial, joined to the word. The strip at the left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. "Coloss." is printed with a double s. The number "10.18." for "Umbra legis" is printed as "10.1ℵ" in the scan and is read here as 10.18; this is doubtful. The left column line "Vescatur pane" wraps onto a second line "10.", which is kept as its own line. No catchword or signature is visible.
